clips.title: The story
paras: Madame Eva seeks ghost hair in the hills south of Darkshire. She needs the strands to spin Ghost Hair Thread for Abercrombie, and sends travelers to find Blind Mary at an abandoned farmhouse. An ethereal comb lets them gather hair from the tormented spirit.

Madame Eva needs ghost hair to spin thread for Abercrombie. Linen and wool cannot serve the rituals of Duskwood, so she gives you a Spectral Comb to gather strands from a spirit. It can pass through the veil of death and catch loose spectral hair without violence.

South of Darkshire, Blind Mary haunts an abandoned farmhouse. The tormented spirit despairs over her appearance and screams at intruders to look away. In anguish over what she had become, she tore out her own eyes. The Spectral Comb offers a brief comfort: she can groom her ghostly hair, though her torment continues.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: There is a poor, sad spirit, Blind Mary, who haunts an old farm house in the hills south of Darkshire.
Here, take this Spectral Comb and ask Blind Mary to comb her hair. Then bring back the comb and I will glean from it the Ghost Hair I'll need for the thread.
And take care, for dark things now lurk near that house...

clips.title: Progress
paras: Oh please, don't look at me! I tore out these eyes with my own hands, but I can still feel your gaze!
I'm hideous! Hideous! Please, look away!!

clips.title: Completion
paras: What is this? A comb? It's lovely! And it glides through my hair as if it weren't the stiff, stringy horror that it is.
Oh, if only I had a mirror...
